1.consolidated_definition: teatr. espec. Tipo de espectáculo artístico multidisciplinario, frecuente en los años cincuenta y sesenta, que generalmente involucra al auditorio. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Art Moco está dedicada por completo a las artes y contiene reseñas lo mismo de happenings, instalaciones y fotografía que de arte digital (El Nuevo Día, 06-07-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Theatrical performance, specifically a type of multidisciplinary artistic spectacle that was common in the 1950s and 1960s, often involving the audience. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. Art Moco is dedicated entirely to the arts and features reviews of happenings, installations, and photography as well as digital art (El Nuevo Día, 06-07-06)
